prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: 2D game animation atlas.
Recreate image 2 with the character design from image 1. Image 1 is the ONLY character identity/material/style reference. Image 2 is ONLY the pose sequence and camera/layout guide.
Action Death2; direction 067, facing ENE, nominal rotation 67.5 degrees clockwise from back/up.
EXACTLY 24 frames, in 6 columns and 4 rows, uniformly sized square cells. All cells occupied; chronological order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Canvas requested 3072x2048 pixels. No labels, words, numbers, lines or borders.
ANIMATION: Second death. Follow the source's distinct collapse trajectory and final corpse pose; no loop. Each corresponding cell must match image 2's pose, body angle, arm/leg configuration, camera angle and within-cell placement. Maintain the source's elevated orthographic game camera. Do not replace animation with repeated standing poses. No motion blur or overlapping frames.
CHARACTER: same thin gray-green corpse, stringy dark hair, skull-like damaged face and exposed teeth, ragged dark sleeveless vest, exposed ribs, rusted iron collar and chest padlock, crossed leather harness, keys on waist belt, torn faded gray trousers, dirty limb wraps, skeletal bare feet with ankle shackles and short chains, small embedded rusty nails. Match the original HD image's detailed inked and painted dark fantasy art. Keep anatomy, face, clothing, locks, nails, straps and chain placement consistent in every frame. No blue jeans or bald head from the pose reference. Back views show the BACK of this character, side views true profiles, never paste frontal face onto back views. Keep lighting constant.
REGISTRATION: exact invisible grid, one complete character per cell, no limb or chain clipping, no shadows or ground props. Keep figure at about 65 percent of cell height in standing poses, source-relative footprint in lying poses, and generous margins.
BACKGROUND: ONLY a perfectly flat solid vivid magenta #FF00FF background for later alpha extraction. Absolutely NO checkerboard, no white or gray backdrop, no gradients, no texture. Never put magenta on the character.
This is a usable animation atlas, not a decorative contact sheet. Priority: exact frame count and grid, correct direction, source motion, consistent identity and clean silhouette.
